subject: Aperture integration pact & readiness lab — mutual action plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya White <maya.white@aperture.consult>
Cc: PartnerOps <partners@aperture.consult>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aperture integration pact & readiness lab — mutual action plan

Hi Maya,

Great to meet you on the call earlier — excited to get Aperture onboarded as a consulting partner for our Integrator Program. Per our conversation I’ve sketched a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a proposed 3-day Readiness Lab so we can ramp your delivery teams on Redwood’s runtime, integration patterns, and observability hooks.

High-level proposed MAP (attach: Aperture_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Week 0: NDA + procurement kickoff (SOW + PO)
- Week 1: Technical intake + sandbox access (security checklist)
- Week 2: Readiness Lab (3 days): core runtime, embeddings, batching, routing policies
- Week 3: Pilot run + joint demo + close success criteria

Readiness Lab objectives:
- Hands-on lab: deploy a small sample model to a sandbox Dedicated pool
- Validate latency and batching knobs with your typical prompt set
- Integrate Redwood Console tracing and create per-route dashboards

Proposed lab dates: April 13–15, 2026 (we can shift). I’ve attached a draft agenda (readiness-lab-agenda.pdf) and the MAP workbook.

Action items for today:
1) Can you confirm the lead engineer(s) who will attend the lab and their time zones?
2) Does Aperture have any procurement timelines or PO templates we should factor in?
3) Any mandatory security evidence besides SOC2 / pen tests?

I’ll loop Laura from Partner Success to scope the enablement materials and Vanessa to coordinate logistics.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partner Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Aperture_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72KB)

Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Aperture integration pact & readiness lab — mutual action plan

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear MAP.

Quick answers:
- Lead engineers who will attend: Evan Cole (Platform Lead) and Priya Shah (Integration Lead) — both are in ET. They can commit to the full 3 days.
- Procurement: we need a standard SOW + invoice; Procurement prefers net-30 and usually routes contracts through our central vendor portal. I’ll share PO templates ASAP.
- Security: SOC2 Type II is the baseline for us. For production pilots we often request a brief on data retention and encryption-at-rest policies. Also confirm whether the readiness lab requires any Q/A access to customer data (it should not).

We’re good with Apr 13–15 pending procurement and SOW. Can you include a pre-lab technical intake call the week before?

Best,
Maya White
Head of Partner Engineering
Aperture Consulting

2) Security evidence: we will attach our SOC2 summary and a one-page Data Handling Overview to the SOW. I’ll ask Sergio to add a short note on encryption/KMS options.
3) Procurement: I’ve attached a draft SOW (SOW-redwood-aperture-v0.2.docx). If Procurement needs a separate PO template, please send and we’ll align with Finance.

Vanessa — can you confirm facilitator availability for Apr 13–15 and whether we should run the lab remotely or as a hybrid session? We typically run the lab as remote hands-on sessions but can do a one-day onsite if Aperture prefers.

Laura — please prepare the enablement pack: quickstart labs, sample prompts for latency checks, and a post-lab acceptance checklist.

Sergio — FYI on the intake; please prepare SOC2 summary and a link to the sandbox provisioning runbook.

Jordan
